summary: Visual table built on a native <table>: presentation only, stateless. For sorting, filtering, selection, and pagination use DataTable.
whenToUse: Static or pre-processed data (summaries, invoices, specifications).
whenNotToUse: Interactive lists with sorting or selection: use DataTable.

props.name: density
props.description: Cell padding; by default follows the theme density.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Header stays fixed during vertical scrolling (with maxHeight).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the scroll area.

props.name: scrollRegionLabel
props.description: Name of the scroll region (keyboard-focusable when it overflows).

props.name: TableCell.numeric
props.description: Aligns to the end with tabular figures.

props.name: TableRow.isSelected
props.description: Visual highlight; also convey the state in the content.

inherits: HTML attributes of each table element.

keyboard.action: If the table overflows, the scroll region is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys.

accessibility: Native semantics: caption, th with scope, tfoot.
TableCaption provides the table's accessible name.
responsive: Horizontal overflow is confined to the scroll region: never on the page.
On mobile, consider priority columns or a card view.
commonMistakes: Using Table for data the user needs to sort: it lacks state and aria-sort.
Omitting the caption or an accessible name.

examples.name: SelectableRows
examples.title: Selectable rows with total
examples.description: Controlled selection with labeled checkboxes, an indeterminate “select all”, and a row highlighted with isSelected.

examples.name: WideWithMissingData
examples.title: Wide table with missing data
examples.description: Horizontal scrolling, long text, empty cells with hidden text, and switches for density and striped rows.
